# Roy Gardner

## Overview

- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v3 c25 P47](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0047)</sub>
- **Origin:** Kingsport  <sub>[v3 c25 P47](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0047)</sub>
- **Role:** Student  <sub>[v3 c25 P47](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0047)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Roy  <sub>[v3 c25 P47](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0047)</sub>

## Appearance

Roy is adorably handsome with glorious, dark, dreamy eyes. He possesses a deep, black, velvety smile. His sister Dorothy resembles him, though she has roguish hazel eyes rather than his dreamy dark ones.

_Sources: [v3 c25 P47](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0047), [v3 c25 P48](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0048), [v3 c26 P18](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0018), [v3 c36 P24](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0024)_

## Personality

Roy is romantic, clever, and soft-spoken, possessing a pleading voice and unfailing, deferential courtesy. He is seen as a melancholy, inscrutable hero type who completely lacks a sense of humor and fails to see the point of jokes. Although he appears deeply interesting, his sister describes him as not being interesting at all in practice.

_Sources: [v3 c25 P47](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0047), [v3 c26 P18](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0018), [v3 c27 P36](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0036), [v3 c39 P2](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0002)_

## History

Roy Gardner belonged to one of the wealthiest and most prominent families in Kingsport. Two years prior to returning to Redmond, he had to leave his college class to travel abroad with his mother when her health failed. Upon returning, he actively courted Anne Shirley, sending her white orchids, boxes of violets accompanied by poetical sonnets, and writing exquisite letters twice a week. He regularly escorted her to social functions and visited Patty's Place, where Aunt Jamesina and her friends grew fond of him. After Anne graduated from Redmond, Roy took her out and proposed marriage to her, but she turned him down.

_Sources: [v3 c25 P47](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0047), [v3 c26 P1](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0001), [v3 c26 P18](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0018), [v3 c27 P36](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0036), [v3 c28 P22](../source/v03-c28.md#nw-v03-c28-p0022), [v3 c37 P31](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0031), [v3 c38 P29](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0029), [v3 c38 P35](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0035)_
